Graduate Students
Graduate Students
Admissions for graduate and professional students
In Rowan University’s graduate programs, you’ll lead next-level breakthroughs on campus, in our community and in your field. Learn more about attending the Northeast’s fastest-growing public research university.
Apply Now
Explore our graduate programs
Our graduate students make a difference while achieving their personal goals. They create supportive classrooms, strengthen networks and grow as entrepreneurs, counselors and healthcare leaders.
Study in person or online to get ahead wherever you are, at any career stage. Explore now and apply.
All Graduate Programs
All Graduate Programs
Flex your academic muscle. Specialize for licensure. Change careers. For all possible directions, our master’s, doctoral and graduate certificates will get you there.
Explore All Graduate Programs
4+1 Programs
4+1 Programs
Complete a bachelor’s and master’s degree in just five years. Our accelerated 4+1 pathways help you rise in law and justice, engineering, education, science and more fields.
Explore All Accelerated Programs
Professional Programs
Professional Programs
We are just one of two universities to offer MD, DO and DVM programs under one roof. We’re also home to New Jersey’s only osteopathic medical school.
Explore All Professional Programs
Online Graduate Programs
Online Graduate Programs
Our flexible, affordable online graduate degrees power your future on your timeline. Explore convenient master’s, Ph.D. and certificate programs in education, business, nursing and more areas.
Explore All Online Graduate Programs

Why attend graduate school at Rowan?
Rowan graduate students drive innovation from Revolutionary War battlefields to the front lines of cancer care. In all programs, our students learn from leading experts and engage with our industry and community partners.
Our faculty are active researchers, clinicians, and practitioners who bring current knowledge into every classroom and mentor students as they shape their fields.
Ready to find your path? Explore Rowan’s graduate programs and discover where your curiosity can take you.
Ph.D. student seeks to short-circuit disease
Connor Castro, a biomedical engineering Ph.D. student, wants to reprogram cells to respond differently to harmful cues — potentially leading to new, more effective cell therapies.
Learn More
25+
Research centers and institutes in advanced manufacturing, transportation, behavioral analysis, artificial intelligence, neuromusculoskeletal disorders and more areas.
Centers and Institutes
R2
Rowan is a rising Carnegie R2 doctoral research university. We already operate at the highest R1 level and expect official designation in the next review cycle.

New graduate students
Ready to take your place among Rowan’s 4,900 graduate students? After saving your spot, contact the Graduate Advising Team at the Office of Advising and Student Information Services (OASIS) to register for courses and approve your aid.
Confirm your spot

Our graduate students celebrate each other, regardless of career stage or academic specialty. Throughout, we help you do meaningful work by providing research guidance and career support.
